description: 10-90 % rise of the centred RMS of a saw note with a linear attack, with the layer's window and with the #69 window.

issue_figures.why: the issue gives ranges over estimators; a row reproduces when the #69 window's rise lies within one hop of its range

name: 69-attack

recipe.issue: the #69 window: two periods of f0 and at least 5 ms, in whole periods
recipe.note: one saw note, harmonic h at 1/h up to 6 kHz, at phase uniform(31, 1) cycles and level 0.3, from 0.2 s; a linear attack to 1, then a decay linear in dB over 0.2 s to -6 dB, held to 0.8 s past the attack and released linearly over 50 ms
recipe.ours: a window of one period of f0, or the fewest whole periods spanning 2 ms
recipe.top: ours rises to the attack's top: the first frame from the onset that the level exceeds by less than 1 dB over as long again as it took to rise to it from under 10 % of it, and at least over the shortest rise the track can tell, here 1.5 RMS windows, and the shares are of the highest frame over that span; the #69 window rises to the highest frame from the onset on
recipe.track: centred RMS on a 1 ms hop from 30 ms before the onset

tolerance_note: rise_s within 0.1 ms: both sides read the same frames, and the saws differ only in the last bits of their sines
